title: Project Manager AI Playbook
subtitle: Reusable AI instructions for every phase of a project. Works in Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Gemini, GitHub Copilot or any AI assistant your company allows.

stages.name: Start the project
stages.goal: Get clear on scope, people, decision rights and how the team will work.

skills.name: project-manager
skills.when: Set up a project: charter, plan, RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), change control and status.
skills.try: Help me set up a new project: migrating our customer portal to a new platform in 5 months, 2 teams, a fixed launch date. Start with the charter and a RAID log.

skills.name: stakeholder-map
skills.when: Map who has power and interest, and plan how to engage each group.
skills.try: Map stakeholders for a CRM replacement: sponsor (CFO), sales leadership, 40 sales reps, IT security, an outside vendor and the data team.

skills.name: daci-framework
skills.when: Agree who Drives, Approves, Contributes and is Informed for a decision, before it stalls.
skills.try: Set up a DACI for choosing between two vendors for our new ticketing tool. Budget sign-off sits with the VP of Operations.

skills.name: working-agreements
skills.when: Charter a new team: purpose, working agreements and a first Definition of Done.
skills.try: We just formed a 7-person cross-functional team across two time zones. Facilitate a 90-minute chartering session.

skills.name: pm-onboarding
skills.when: Build a 30-60-90 day plan when you join a new project, program or company.
skills.try: I'm taking over a delayed program next Monday. Build my 30-60-90 day plan: who to meet, what to ask, and early wins.

stages.name: Plan the work
stages.goal: Break big work down, sequence it, surface risk early and agree what matters most.

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.when: Work is too big or unclear for one sprint: map the open decisions, resolve them in order, then create tickets.
skills.try: We need to add single sign-on to three internal apps and nobody knows where to start. Map the decisions we need to make first.

skills.name: quarterly-planning
skills.when: Plan a quarter: capacity, commitments versus stretch, cross-team dependencies.
skills.try: Plan Q3 for two teams (11 people, one starting parental leave in August). Leadership wants 6 initiatives; help us decide what fits.

skills.name: outcome-roadmap
skills.when: Turn a feature list into a Now / Next / Later roadmap of outcomes, each with a measure.
skills.try: Turn this into an outcome roadmap: new dashboard, CSV export, SSO, mobile app, faster search, audit log.

skills.name: dependency-map
skills.when: Find cross-team dependencies and rank them by risk.
skills.try: Map dependencies for a release that needs the payments team's new API, a security review and a vendor contract renewal.

skills.name: pre-mortem
skills.when: Imagine the project failed, list why, and give each risk an owner and a mitigation.
skills.try: Run a pre-mortem for our ERP go-live on 1 March. 300 users, a two-week cutover window, and the vendor is new to us.

skills.name: plan-grilling
skills.when: Stress-test a plan one round of questions at a time until every decision is settled.
skills.try: Grill this plan: we move 4 teams to a new deployment pipeline in 6 weeks, one team at a time, with no change freeze.

skills.name: prioritization-frameworks
skills.when: Choose and apply a prioritization method (RICE, MoSCoW, WSJF, Kano and others).
skills.try: Prioritize these 8 requests from three departments using WSJF. Here is what I know about value and effort for each: ...

skills.name: create-prd
skills.when: Write a requirements document that frames the problem before the solution.
skills.try: Write a PRD for automating our monthly vendor invoice approval, which today takes 3 days of email back and forth.

stages.name: Run delivery
stages.goal: Keep work moving: blockers, scope creep, decisions, meetings and releases.

skills.name: delivery-manager
skills.when: Plan releases, run a Go/No-Go, choose a deployment strategy, handle an incident.
skills.try: Prepare the Go/No-Go checklist for Friday's release. Two open bugs are rated medium and the on-call engineer is new.

skills.name: impediment-log
skills.when: Log, triage and escalate a blocker, and draft the escalation message.
skills.try: We've waited 9 days for firewall access from another department. Help me escalate it without burning the relationship.

skills.name: protect-the-sprint
skills.when: Handle mid-sprint requests and scope creep, and draft the reply to the stakeholder.
skills.try: A director asked my team to 'squeeze in' a new report this sprint. We're at full capacity. Draft my reply.

skills.name: decision-questionnaire
skills.when: Get a decision from a busy stakeholder in writing, without scheduling a meeting.
skills.try: I need the VP to choose between delaying launch two weeks or cutting the reporting feature. Write a questionnaire she can answer in 5 minutes.

skills.name: problem-solver
skills.when: Diagnose a recurring problem before fixing it: problem statement and verified root causes.
skills.try: Our releases have slipped 4 of the last 6 months. Help me find the real cause before we change the process.

skills.name: meeting-analyzer
skills.when: Turn meeting notes into a register of who committed to what; diagnose meetings that decide nothing.
skills.try: Here are notes from our last 4 weekly steering meetings. Pull out every commitment and tell me which items keep rolling over.

skills.name: summarize-meeting
skills.when: Summarize one meeting into decisions, action items with owners, and open questions.
skills.try: Summarize this transcript into decisions, action items with owners and due dates, and open questions.

skills.name: test-scenarios
skills.when: Write QA test cases from a spec, including edge, error and security paths.
skills.try: Write test scenarios for a new expense-claim form: upload receipt, pick cost center, submit for approval.

stages.name: Monitor and report
stages.goal: Know where the project really stands and tell people clearly.

skills.name: senior-pm
skills.when: Score portfolio health, risk exposure and resource capacity; frame executive status reports.
skills.try: Here are my 5 projects with budget, schedule and risk data. Score their health and draft the portfolio summary for the steering committee.

skills.name: status-update-generator
skills.when: Write a weekly status update: RAG status, progress, risks and asks.
skills.try: Write this week's status update. We finished data migration testing, the vendor delivery slipped a week, and we need a decision on training dates.

skills.name: program-manager
skills.when: Coordinate several related projects: roadmap, dependencies, governance.
skills.try: I run a program of 4 projects that all feed a new billing system. Set up the governance and a monthly program review.

skills.name: cycle-time-analyzer
skills.when: Analyze cycle time and throughput to find where work gets stuck and forecast delivery.
skills.try: Here's an export of 60 tickets with start and done dates. Where does work get stuck, and when will the remaining 25 be done?

skills.name: metrics-conversation
skills.when: Present delivery metrics to leadership without them being misused.
skills.try: My manager wants to compare teams by velocity. Help me explain why that backfires and what to show instead.

stages.name: Communicate and lead
stages.goal: The right message to the right audience, and strong working relationships.

skills.name: roadmap-communication
skills.when: Produce executive, customer and internal versions of one roadmap.
skills.try: Turn our Q2 roadmap into three versions: a one-slide exec summary, a customer-facing note, and an internal team version.

skills.name: team-communications
skills.when: Design how the team communicates: channels, meeting load, status structure, escalation.
skills.try: My team has 14 hours of recurring meetings a week. Redesign our communication setup to cut that in half.

skills.name: pm-1on1s
skills.when: Plan 1:1s with your manager, engineering leads and partners.
skills.try: Build an agenda for my first 1:1 with the new engineering manager on my project. Things are tense after a missed deadline.

stages.name: Launch and close
stages.goal: Ship safely, tell people, learn from it.

skills.name: launch-playbook
skills.when: Coordinate a launch from 30 days before to 30 days after: owners, run-of-show, comms, rollback, retro.
skills.try: Build the launch plan for our new customer self-service portal going live in 4 weeks.

skills.name: beta-program
skills.when: Run a pilot or closed beta with exit criteria agreed before it starts.
skills.try: Plan a 6-week pilot of our new scheduling tool with 3 regional offices before company-wide rollout.

skills.name: feature-flag-strategy
skills.when: Plan a phased rollout with a kill switch.
skills.try: Plan a phased rollout of the new checkout flow: 5%, 25%, 100%, with clear rollback triggers.

skills.name: release-notes
skills.when: Turn tickets and changelogs into release notes people will read.
skills.try: Turn this list of 18 closed tickets into release notes for business users. Put anything that changes their daily work first.

skills.name: eol-communication
skills.when: Retire a system or feature: dated milestones, migration path, messages per audience.
skills.try: We retire the old reporting tool on 30 September. Plan the announcements for power users, occasional users and managers.

skills.name: post-mortem
skills.when: Run a blameless review after a missed launch, incident or failed project.
skills.try: Run a blameless post-mortem on our go-live that was rolled back after 6 hours.

stages.name: Work tools
stages.goal: Get more out of Jira, Confluence and other work tools.

skills.name: jira-expert
skills.when: Jira workflows, JQL queries, boards, dashboards and automation.
skills.try: Write JQL for all open bugs in projects PORTAL and API that have been in 'In Review' for more than 5 days.

skills.name: confluence-expert
skills.when: Set up or clean up Confluence spaces, page trees, permissions and stale pages.
skills.try: Design a Confluence space structure for a program with 4 projects, a steering committee and a vendor.

skills.name: atlassian-templates
skills.when: Build reusable Jira issue and Confluence page templates people actually fill in.
skills.try: Create a Confluence template for a weekly project status page and a Jira template for a change request.

skills.name: notion-pm
skills.when: Design Notion databases and views for projects, decisions and roadmaps.
skills.try: Design a Notion setup for tracking 10 projects with status, owner, RAG, risks and decisions.

skills.name: linear-expert
skills.when: Set up Linear teams, cycles, projects and triage.
skills.try: Set up Linear for 3 teams that share one product, with a shared triage queue.
